name: Non Financial Response Risk 1 Code
definition: Type of risk management answer from an Acquirer (or its IntermediaryAgent) to aPOI through a NonFinancialResponse.

DECL.name: Decline
DECL.definition: A decline of the transaction is expected by the POI to manage risk.

NCHG.name: Locally Managed
NCHG.definition: The POI is able to assess the risk by himself.

ONLN.name: Request Online
ONLN.definition: An authorisation is expected from the POI to manage risk.
